game.title: Stellaris
game.blurb: 4X space strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, published by Paradox Interactive, released 2016-05-08. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Strategy, Simulation. A 4X game has no story chapters, so these chapters are built from Steam achievement themes: empire building, war, diplomacy, megastructures, galaxy encounters, relics, empire types and origins, and victories and crises.

chapters.title: Building Your Empire
chapters.summary: Colonising, mining and energy income, pops, robots, terraforming, genetics, trade and traditions.

chapters.title: Fleets and War
chapters.summary: Fleet power, wars, conquest, starbases, Titans, Colossi, Juggernauts and planetary defences.

chapters.title: Diplomacy, Federations and Espionage
chapters.summary: Federations, vassals and subjects, the Galactic Community, first contact, espionage and the council.

chapters.title: Megastructures
chapters.summary: Dyson Spheres, Ring Worlds, the Science Nexus, Gateways, habitats, Hyper Relays and the other great constructions.

chapters.title: Galaxy Encounters
chapters.summary: Space creatures, Fallen Empires, enclaves, Patrons and Covenants, Astral Rifts, the Shroud and other strange finds.

chapters.title: Precursors, Relics and Archaeology
chapters.summary: Archaeological sites, Minor Artifacts, Relics (including the Ancient Relics Story Pack), precursor chains and the Galatron.

chapters.title: Empire Types, Ethics and Origins
chapters.summary: Goals for playing a particular kind of empire, ethic, civic or origin.

chapters.title: Victories and Crises
chapters.summary: Winning, defeating the end-game crises and invaders, and the galaxy-ending choices.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 281990 ("Stellaris" in the store list); its schema returns an empty game name but a full list of 219 achievements, none hidden, most below 10%. The only add-ons named in the achievements are the "Ancient Relics Story Pack" and the "Ketling Star Pack"; many origin and empire-type goals likely come from add-ons too, but the data does not say which. Four achievements about red giant stars, volcanic worlds and Blazing Scourge decisions sit with the victories and crises because they come right after the Hyperthermia Crisis Path achievement in the Steam list and two of them mention the Galactic Firestorm victory. RAWG also lists "Stellaris: Console Edition" and "Stellaris: Galaxy Command" separately; this entry is the PC game. No StrategyWiki page under "Stellaris". stellaris.fandom.com answers the API under "Stellaris", but the page links to only one article ("Empire"), so it adds almost nothing; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
